note: Machine-readable manifest of the DOM invariants asserted in-page by scripts/qa/inpage.js runAssertions(). The runner is the source of truth; keep this file in sync when assertions change.

assertions.description: The progress screen exists and the pipeline rail rendered at least one node.
assertions.fails_when: #screen-progress is missing or zero .pipeline-node elements are in the DOM

assertions.description: Exactly nine processing modules are rendered in the progress rack.
assertions.fails_when: the .module count is anything other than 9 (missing or duplicated module)

assertions.description: Every module detail shows a real value after the fixture replay, not an idle placeholder.
assertions.rule: at least one .module-detail exists AND no detail text is empty, 'in attesa...', or matches /^in attesa di dati/i
assertions.fails_when: a .module-detail is empty or still shows an idle label after replay

assertions.description: A cancel control is reachable in the document.
Each of the five mix sliders has a live value readout as a sibling inside its .field.
assertions.rule: for each id: #<id> exists AND #<id>-val exists AND slider.closest('.field') contains the readout
assertions.fails_when: a slider is missing, its #<id>-val readout is missing, or the readout is outside the slider's .field

assertions.description: The plugin panel exists and shows live content after the replay (character_processor + plugin_hosted).
assertions.rule: [data-qa="plugin-panel"] exists AND #plugin-panel-body text is non-empty AND contains 'QA Test Plugin'
assertions.fails_when: the panel is missing, its body is empty, or the hosted plugin name is not rendered

assertions.description: No console.error or window.onerror fired during load and replay.
assertions.fails_when: any console.error or uncaught window.onerror was captured
